# Barefoot Fishing Safaris

> Guided barramundi, sportfishing and fly fishing charters in Australia's Top End
> (Northern Territory), run by Glenn "Watty" Watt since 2011. Part of the Barefoot
> Outdoors family. Everyone fishes with Watty — no blow-in guides.

## About
- Owner/guide: Glenn "Watty" Watt — Top End fishing guide since 2011, barramundi
  authority, host of the Barefoot Outdoors podcast, and Managing Director of Angling
  Adventures (hosted international fishing trips).
- Base: Coolalinga, Northern Territory. Contact: 0417 272 871,
  glenn@barefootfishingsafaris.com.au

## Safaris
(Also searched as: fishing charters Darwin, barramundi fishing tours NT,
Top End fishing guide.)
- Run Off Barra (mid Feb–end May): peak barramundi, lodge-based 3–8 day trips.
- Dundee & Bynoe Harbour (late Aug–early Dec): dry-season barra and bluewater.
- Fly fishing (mid Feb–end Nov): three seasons — run-off (mid Feb–end May),
  dry (early Jun–end Aug) and build-up (early Sep–end Nov). Max two anglers per boat.

## Online courses (the Barra Brain app)
- All of Watty's course material is moving into Barra Brain, one app: from the free
  4 Pillars of Top End Barra Fishing through to the full Top End Barra Secrets program.
- Free reading on the site: The 4 Pillars of Top End Barra Fishing; the Tides Cheat
  Sheet; the Black Books (per-trip guides).

## Angling Adventures (sister business)
- Hosted trips worldwide: Bensbach PNG, Christmas Island, Alaska, Costa Rica, and more.

## Radio & podcast archive (full transcripts)
- 250 episodes, 2019-2026, each with audio and a complete written transcript:
  https://barefootfishingsafaris.com.au/media
- "Bag a Barra" — Watty's weekly segment on Oz Off Road Radio (3AW/Nine), 229 episodes.
- "Fishing on Arvos" — ABC Radio Darwin fishing segments.
- Long-form interviews: The Intermediate Line (2021), Hooked (2019), Guys in the Gulf (2026).
- 12 video appearances (Starlo Gets Reel, Peachy Fly Fishing, Oz Off Road TV,
  The SegmeNT, Fishing Addiction, NextGen North) — each with a full transcript.

## In-depth articles (written by Watty, with Q&A)
- Long-form guides to Top End barramundi fishing, each ending in a plain Q&A
  section: reading choke points, fishing points, fishing the snags, fishing rocks.
- Browse them in the Media Centre: https://barefootfishingsafaris.com.au/media
- More are being added from Watty's own course material and radio archive.

## What Watty says about… (topic pages, quotes + sources)
- Browse every subject: https://barefootfishingsafaris.com.au/topics
- Places: Kakadu, Dundee, Darwin Harbour, Shady Camp, South/East Alligator,
  Adelaide River, Mary River, Daly River.
- Seasons & water: the run-off, wet season, dry season, build-up, billabongs,
  floodplain, monsoon, moon and tides.
- Technique: fly fishing, casting, fishing the snags, vibes and soft plastics, trolling.
- Species: saratoga, queenfish, golden snapper, threadfin, tarpon, trevally, sharks.
Each topic page carries verbatim quotes with a link to the audio and full transcript.
